raw_segments.text: Leance, make that thy question and go rot.
Dost think I am so muddy, so unsettled, to appoint myself in this vexation, sully the
purity and whiteness of my sheets.
Which to preserve is sleep, which being spotted is goads, thorns, nettles, tales of wasps.
Give scandal to the blood-o, T.H., Prince, my son, who I do think is mine and love is
